exposure: blood pressure during epidural window (one hour before and after epidural procedure start time)
blood pressure severity during epidural window
cohort: The study included 1800 previously normotensive nulliparous, singleton, term patients who received neuraxial analgesia and delivered at the institution in 2016.
finding: Previously normotensive patients with an elevated blood pressure during labor epidural placement are significantly more likely to develop a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (HDP) prior to discharge.
